messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: P0 - Hosted API latency spike (us-west-2). 99th percentile tokens > 5s. Paging on-call.
ryan_oncall: I'm looking. Seeing backlog on gpu-pool-3. Digging into queue sizes.
ana_sre: @ryan_oncall :point_up: logs show a surge of long-context requests from a small client set. Attaching tail logs.
ryan_oncall: thx. running quick check: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep gpu` -> some pods at 100% CPU
elena_eng: rolling restart of batch-workers reduces CPU but does not affect current frontends. Can we throttle batcher?
ana_sre: switching batcher to conservative mode now: `POST /admin/batcher?mode=conservative` -> in progress
ops-bot: CHANGE: batcher mode set to conservative by ana_sre at 2026-11-04T01:12Z
ryan_oncall: latency improving for tail requests. still seeing longer KV cache misses.
jamie_comms: need a customer-facing blurb. Drafting initial update for public page; will paste for review.
jamie_comms: DRAFT:
```
We are investigating increased latency on our Hosted Inference API (us-west-2). Some requests are experiencing delayed responses. Our engineers are actively mitigating and we will provide updates every 30 minutes. No data loss is expected.
```
alex_product: add note: "affects text generation endpoints only, embeddings unaffected" if confirmed
elena_eng: confirmed embeddings unaffected.
jamie_comms: updated draft. Internal note for severity: P0; currently mitigation in progress. Ready to publish initial message pending ops signoff.
ryan_oncall: ops signoff: publish initial.
jamie_comms: publishing initial update to status page and sending customer notify via email webhook.
jamie_comms: PUBLISH CMD:
```
/status publish --incident-id=inc-1840032109 --message="Investigating increased latency in Hosted API (us-west-2). Engineers are mitigating; next update in 30 minutes." --visibility=public
```
ops-bot: STATUSPAGE: draft created at https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/inc-1840032109
ops-bot: NOTIFY: customer/email webhook queued (target: customers@redwood.ai)
ryan_oncall: handing off to @ana_sre for second shift. I'm going to sleep (tz: PST). Leave any followups here.
ana_sre: taking over. continuing root cause analysis, focusing on KV cache warming and client-side bursts.
jamie_comms: schedule next update for 30 mins. If we have measurable improvement, include recovery ETA.
ana_sre: found problematic client pattern: repeated long-context retries causing batch fragmentation. Throttled client at edge (rate-limit applied).
ops-bot: ACTION: rate-limit applied to x-client-id=abc123 by ana_sre
elena_eng: applying hotfix to batcher to prefer small-context grouping. Deploying canary now.
ops-bot: DEPLOY: batcher-fix canary started by elena_eng
ana_sre: after throttling + canary, 99p latency dropped from 5.2s -> 1.1s over 12 minutes.
jamie_comms: drafting 2nd update: DRAFT:
```
Update: Mitigations (rate-limiting of abnormal client, batcher config change) have reduced elevated latency for most traffic. We continue monitoring. A final status update will follow when fully resolved.
```
ryan_oncall: thanks team. will check in later.
jamie_comms: publishing update.
ops-bot: STATUSPAGE: update published at https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/inc-1840032109#update-2
jamie_comms: also sent targeted email to affected customers with mitigation summary.
ana_sre: continuing monitoring. no error rate increase. KV hit-rate slowly improving.
elena_eng: promoting batcher fix to stable.
ops-bot: DEPLOY: batcher-fix promoted to stable by elena_eng
ana_sre: final check: traffic normalized for 60m, 99p < 500ms. No data integrity issues.
jamie_comms: DRAFT RESOLVED NOTICE:
```
Resolved: We have implemented mitigations and deployed a batcher fix. The Hosted API in us-west-2 is fully recovered and operating normally. If you continue to see latency, please contact support.
```
ryan_oncall: verified. closing handoff. great work.
jamie_comms: published resolved notice and closed incident on status page.
ops-bot: STATUSPAGE: incident inc-1840032109 marked resolved at 2026-11-04T02:05Z
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: inc-1840032109
